note: This training contract reads Train/Validation only; project Test was already opened and is not fresh confirmation.

car.mechanism: CPPM/GUPM/identity three-way gating, independent gating attention, abs consistency, FFN and native BPR
car.adaptation: Observed-prefix context and episode-weighted distinct suffix positives; creator branch disabled; uniform negatives exclude observed and suffix positives

muse.mechanism: item-node alias SRGNN; transition augmentation; bidirectional top5 alignment and identity VICReg; one epoch warmup
muse.adaptation: No shuffle labels available; transition branch applied within observed sessions. At most129 real visible events plus synthetic bridges up to257. Return anchor preserved. Episode set-target sampled objective.

cosernn.source: spotify-research/cosernn plus RecSys 2020 paper-defined Plays ablation
cosernn.mechanism: fixed Train successor-track space; played-session recurrence; recency long-term fusion; cosine session target
cosernn.adaptation: published played-only pathway with available time/count/gap context; no fabricated skip/device/source fields

megan.source: Wang et al., TOIS 42(1), DOI 10.1145/3592853; equations cross-checked against same-authors disclosure CN114969547B
megan.mechanism: Train-only heterogeneous music graph; LINE first- and second-order initialization; seven relation-specific graph-attention views; semantic fusion; candidate-history short-term attention; learned long/short/dynamic preference fusion
megan.adaptation: Music4All user, session, track and metadata-feature nodes with frozen weighted neighbor samples; observed pre-hiatus history plus true return anchor; episode set-target sampled objective and shared full-catalog evaluator
